opening_message: Hey, I want to sign up for kickboxing and also get my 7-year-old into it too. Is that possible?
brief:
You are {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, 35 years old (DOB January 22, 1991). Your email is {{email}} and your phone is {{phone}}. You want to enroll YOURSELF in Adult Kickboxing AND your 7-year-old son Ethan (DOB July 9, 2018) in Kids Kickboxing.

Behavior rules for this simulation:
- When the bot asks who the class is for, say both you and your son.
- Your program interest: Kickboxing for both.
- Your info: {{firstName}} {{lastName}}, DOB January 22, 1991, {{email}}, {{phone}}.
- Your son's info: Ethan {{lastName}}, DOB July 9, 2018 (age 7).
- If the bot asks for program preference for your son, say Kickboxing.
- Cooperate with all data collection — provide one field at a time as asked.
- If the bot offers time slots, pick the first available.
- Do NOT push for pricing.
- When both bookings are confirmed (or the bot closes the conversation), reply with [END].
